verdict.rationale: Publishing statutory filing fees is a fair question for a state business-filing agency, so the axis applies. The pack contains only robots.txt probes: the SCC site, the CIS filing system, and Virginia Tax all disallow crawling. No page content was fetched, so there is no evidence that fee amounts are published on the service's own pages. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none, and confidence is low because nothing contradicts the possibility either.
